narrations.title: The Grumpy Royal March
narrations.narration: Leo the lion was having a very grumpy morning. With his oversized golden crown sitting crookedly on his head and his royal purple velvet cape dragging in the dirt, he stomped through the jungle.

narrations.title: A Rabbit's Clever Idea
narrations.narration: Rosie was busy near a sparkling stream, her teal ribbon fluttering as she wiggled her nose. She saw Leo waddling toward her with his arms crossed tightly over his chest.

narrations.title: The Royal Decree
narrations.narration: Leo stomped his back foot. He reached Rosie and tried to look as intimidating as possible, but Rosie just tapped her chin thoughtfully.

narrations.title: The Rival King
narrations.narration: Leo’s eyes went wide. He adjusted his crown with a flick of his wrist, feeling challenged by the news of a superior lion.

narrations.title: The Well’s Edge
narrations.narration: Rosie bounced ahead, leading the pompous cub to the deep, mossy well. She gestured toward the dark opening.

narrations.title: The Reflection
narrations.narration: Leo leaned over the edge, his fluffy tummy pressing against the stone. He peered into the dark, still water and saw a grumpy lion staring back.

narrations.title: The Great Escape
narrations.narration: Terrified of the ‘scary’ stranger, Leo turned and ran as fast as his chubby legs could carry him, his purple cape flapping behind him like a frantic bird.

narrations.title: Victory Carrot
narrations.narration: Rosie performed a small victory hop and giggled until her whiskers twitched. She pulled a perfectly crunchy carrot from her pinafore pocket and took a satisfied bite.
